biotools.summary: anglemania extracts genes from multi-batch scRNA-seq experiments for downstream dataset integration. It shows improvement over the conventional usage of highly-variable genes for many integration tasks. We leverage gene-gene correlations that are stable across batches to identify biologically informative genes which are less affected by batch effects. Currently, its main use is for single-cell RNA-seq dataset integration, but it can be applied for other multi-batch downstream analyses such as NMF.
